safety.reason: The co-worker observes, analyzes, drafts, and queues; a designated human approves every consequential external action.

product.simulation_type: Synthetic customer-journey diagnosis, intervention drafting, approved development rendering, and optional read-only reply-monitoring service using the unchanged Bibblio parent-feedback demo.

overview: A GTM assistant that converts de-identified customer feedback into journey friction, draft interventions, support escalations, retention evidence, and product priorities.
